body.text: The {param:tribe} have stopped coming to {param:town} to trade. Not one party this month, and they were regular as the tide.
Nobody has quarrelled with them that I know of. That is what worries me. When a man stops talking to you he has usually decided something.
I shall keep a watch. I should be glad to know what you would have me do beyond that.

options.text: and have read it with care
and would rather not have needed it

options.label: see to your defences
options.text: Keep the watch and build on it. If they have decided something I would rather you were ready for it.

options.label: find the trade elsewhere
options.text: Find the trade elsewhere. The town cannot live on one customer.
